summary.text: Stan Ellis, a Republican, represents California's 32nd Assembly District; he won the February 25, 2025 special primary outright and assumed office on March 3, 2025.

paragraphs.text: KVPR described Ellis as a Bakersfield farmer and businessman.
Ellis announced that he will not seek re-election in 2026.

sources.title: Businessman Stan Ellis declares victory in California’s vacant Assembly District 32 seat
Assemblyman Stan Ellis announces he won't seek re-election after less than a year in office
